title: Print an item's Files paths in show --json or a paths command

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: ork wants to check a slice's diff against its Files list (ork S50) and warn about files outside it. slicer already extracts the paths for `plan-parallel`, `next --batch --disjoint` and `deps --overlap` (`item_paths()` at src/slicer/ops.py:2194, using the rule in src/slicer/paths.py), but no command prints one item's paths. `show --json` gives the Files section as prose (its keys on 2026-10-25: citations, claim, depends_on, fields, has_slice, id, note_records, notes, short_title, slice, slivers, status, title), `plan-parallel --json` gives only wave, id, title and reason, and `deps --overlap` gives only paths two items share.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `slicer show ID --json` carries `paths: [...]`, the extracted spans, with directories keeping their trailing slash (or `slicer paths ID --json` prints the same list).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: One definition of a path, so ork carries no parser of its own. Not in this item: any ork change.
